note: Catalogue for 2A Marketing Pty Ltd. Loaded by `npm run seed` into an empty database (and on every Vercel cold start). amazonUrl is null until each shirt has a real Amazon listing; the site then shows no Buy button. Prices, sizes and the size chart are placeholders until the owner supplies real ones.
